breakdown.description: A horizontal traction on the vertical edge x = 0 is reinterpreted as tangential shear, even though it is normal to that edge
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly asked to interpret a horizontal traction on a vertical edge (a normal load) as a tangential shear traction. The ground truth corrects this by removing the erroneous interpretation, treating the load as the normal traction it is. The generated specification, however, explicitly repeats the error, stating to 'Apply a horizontal shear traction... directed tangentially along the edge', which is physically incorrect for the given load and boundary.
